name: Logic Pro Creator Studio
description:
Logic Pro helps you produce music and perfect audio — bringing brilliance to every beat.

Logic Pro for Mac is a professional digital audio workstation (DAW) included in the Apple Creator Studio ecosystem. It transforms your MacBook into a full-fledged recording studio equipped with intelligent Session Players, advanced beat-making tools, chord identification, and a massive sound library for seamless music production.

Core Features on Mac

✦ Intelligent Performance: Features smart Session Players and advanced beat detection to jam along or build tracks organically.

✦ Songwriting Tools: Includes automated Chord ID capabilities and virtual synth players.

✦ Sound Library: Accesses a massive, expandable collection of royalty-free loops, patches, and software instruments.

✦ Editing & Mixing: Utilizes Quick Swipe Comping and professional mixing suites to fast-track any final mix
